summary: PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering (University of Oklahoma, 2025) with university-level undergraduate teaching in Computer Programming, Communication Systems and Wireless Communication; communications laboratory support at UET Taxila and engineering student mentoring at COMSATS. Emphasis on clear technical foundations, practical exercises, inclusive mentoring and learning-outcome assessment. Broad electrical engineering preparation and applied system modeling, optimization, signal analysis and simulation inform course-specific preparation for circuits and control systems. Industry engineering at AT&T Labs, Futurewei and AT&T connects student learning to real-world applications.
